test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.

A. He knew that the man had come there with a specific purpose.

B. He had to sleep to be well rested for the next day’s work.

C. Puller slumped back on his bed.

D. But his thoughts dwelled on a suspicious man whom he had seen.
solution:
The correct answer is **'CBDA'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When we **read the sentences**, we get to know that there are **two characters 'Puller' and 'a suspicious man'.**

 
 
• The sentence **starts from the sentence 'C' **- ***Puller slumped back on his bed.***
 
• The **purpose to slump back on the bed** can be cleared with the help of **the sentence 'B'** - ***He had to sleep to be well-rested for the next day’s work.***
 
• **The condition on the bed **can be expressed by **the sentence 'D' **- ***But his thoughts dwelled on a suspicious man whom he had seen.***
 
• Now the last **sentence 'A' tells more about the suspicious man - *He knew that the man had come there with a specific purpose.***
 
 
 
• By observing the **above-mentioned information**, the **accurate order **should be **'CBDA'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's understand some words in the sentences.

 
• **Suspicious **- ***Doubtful, Distrustful.***
 
• **Dwell - *to live in or at a specified place.***
 
• **Slump back - *to fall or sit down suddenly due to tiredness.***
